name: A finished Dungeon Finder group becomes an ordinary group once every member has left the dungeon
contract: A Dungeon Finder group that finished its dungeon stayed a Dungeon Finder group after every member had left the
instance, so the client kept showing the dungeon as running at the minimap until the group was left.
LFGMgr::ReleaseFinishedDungeon now clears the finder state and the group's finder type when the last member
leaves the finished dungeon's map. The lfg_dungeon fixture only accepts an ordinary group, so its second use
proves the group type. While a member is still inside the group stays finished, and an unfinished run stays a
Dungeon Finder group whose members can teleport back in.
